name: Hyouka no Gen'ya -Eternal Waltz-
source:
Main character temporarily returns to his icy hometown after two and half years. He reunites with childhood friend and goes to the closed school which bears so many nostalgic memories. Protagonist's frozen heart starts to melt little by little in the familiar classroom. They young people meet a strange girl in this abandoned building, and it becomes a turning point in their lives.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角時隔兩年半暫時回到冰雪覆蓋的故鄉，與青梅竹馬重逢，並一同前往那座承載著無數令人懷唸的回憶、如今已經關閉的學校。在熟悉的教室裡，主角凍結的心開始一點點融化。年輕人在廢棄校舍中遇見一名神秘少女，這次相遇成為他們人生的轉折點。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
